hushgram.title: v0.0.22
hushgram.body:
HushGram still patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so you patch the same way as last time. Most of this release came from you: 57 of the changes below started with one of your reports or requests. You can blur a chat behind a message you're holding, record calls, lock a collection right from Saved, keep the tab bar on reel links and hide comments that use your blocked words. There are 44 fixes too.

Fixes

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, a story you open no longer covers the whole screen for a moment before jumping up above the gesture bar. Reported in #618.

- Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.

- The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.

- The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.

- `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.

- `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.

- Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.

- `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.

- Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.

- With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.

- Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.

- The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.

- An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.

- The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.

- `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.

- Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.

- `Fill the screen` goes grey with a line saying why while `Show the whole reel` is on, since that switch wins and reels kept their side bars. Reported in #755.

- `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.

- The seek bar on reels no longer sits under the floating tab bar after you come back from picture in picture. Reported in #450.

- With the tab bar hiding on Reels, dragging a reel's seek bar no longer leaves it sitting on top of the caption once you let go. Reported in #450.

- Logging in with Facebook no longer stops on Facebook's "link may be broken" page and a spinner that never ends. The Facebook app turns away a patched Instagram, so the login goes through your browser now. Reported in #760.

- Reels that run behind the glass tab bar sit where they should again instead of up against the top of the screen with a black band under them. Reported in #763.

- Unfolding a foldable with `Glass tab bar` on keeps every tab in Instagram's side rail now, lined up. Search and your profile used to go missing from it and the rest sat out of line. Reported in #764.

- `Thicker story progress bar` thickens the bar again with a seek bar shape picked. 0.0.21 left a shaped bar as thin as before. Now its line grows like the standard bar's, and the waves keep their size. Reported in #775.

- With `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed` on, tapping a feed video no longer stops it on its cover or leaves it under a play button. Instagram set the video up for Reels before HushGram caught the tap. Reported in #706.

- `Sent follow requests` now catches the Requested button at the top of a profile. Since 456 Instagram sets that button another way, so a request you sent from someone's profile never made it onto the list. Reported in #690.

- `Text size` stays put when you turn your phone or change one of its settings. Captions in the feed went back to your phone's own size after that, until Instagram was closed and opened again. Reported in #782.

- Signing in no longer closes Instagram on a phone without Google Play services, like a de-Googled ROM or one running microG. `Run without Play services` is on by default and has no switch. Reported in #767 and #748.

- On a narrow phone, HushGram's buttons at the top of a chat fold into one More button that holds all of them, so the chat's name shows and the last call button isn't cut off. Reported in #802.

- Bigger text from Text size no longer makes a chat's message box taller. The space around the text shrinks first, and only then does the box's text come down a little, still bigger than the phone's size. Reported in #806.

- `See who a story mentions` brings its list back after you watch the story of a profile you opened from it. Watching that story still closed the list, so going back to the first story left it shut. Reported in #403.

- The Lens button on reels and stories sees the video now instead of a black box. Instagram plays some videos on a layer of its own, which HushGram reads now for Lens and the glass tab bar. Reported in #801 and #583.

- Tap download on more than three things at once and the extra ones wait their turn instead of failing with Download failed. The toasts say whose media it is now, like "Saving from @name...". Asked for in #792.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, the little bars that pop up at the bottom (Link copied, Saved and the like) are black now too. They stayed dark gray. Asked for in #816.

- With `See-through top bar` and the glass tab bar both on, the stories row on Home gets the header's glass shine too, so it no longer sits there as a black band between the glass and the posts. Asked for in #800.

- `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` keeps the suggested people off both Follow requests screens now, the old one and the newer page Notifications opens, even when Instagram sends them anyway. Reported in #814.

- `Find the reel you came from` works for reels in your feed too. Tap the name on a reel in Home, open their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel. Before, only the Reels viewer did this. Reported in #795.

- With the wave `Seek bar shape`, the story you're watching no longer shows Instagram's straight bar running under the wave. The straight part now starts where the wave ends. Reported in #796.

- `Ambient light` now glows around photo and carousel reels and reels Instagram plays on its own video layer, and fills the thin black bars above and below a reel. `Rounded corners on Reels` rounds photo reels too. Reported in #796.

- With `Keep 2x after you let go`, the name over a feed video comes back when you let go, and the time readout goes away. Before, they stayed the way they look while you hold. Reported in #552.

- With `Classic colors` or `Backgrounds in the accent color` on, an open chat takes your page color behind the messages and in its header instead of staying black. Chats with a theme of their own keep it. Reported in #528.

- The Messages list keeps your page color when Instagram opens straight into it from a notification. Its rows stayed black until a restart. Reported in #528.

- With `Glass in chats` on, messages no longer jump up and down as a chat opens or the message bar changes height, and the newest one no longer ends up hidden behind the bar. Reported in #528.

Other changes

- `Blur the chat behind a held message` is new under Messages. Press and hold a message and the rest of the chat blurs behind it, so the message and its reactions stand out. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #684.

- `Glass buttons in chats` is new under `Glass in chats`. Turn it off and the buttons at the top of a chat lose their round glass, leaving a plain blur behind them like Instagram's own. Asked for in #684.

- `Even on silent` is new under `Start feed videos with sound`. With your phone on silent or vibrate, Home's videos still start with their sound, as long as the media volume is up. Starts off. Asked for in #762.

- `Record calls` is new under Messages. A Record button saves both sides of a call to your Recordings folder (Music on Android 11 or older) and stops when the call ends. Some places require everyone's consent. Starts off. Asked for in #732.

- `Chat bubbles` is new under Notifications. A chat's notification gets Android's bubble button, so the chat can float over other apps. Hidden and locked chats never get one. Needs Android 11 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #747.

- Press and hold a collection in Saved to lock it or take its lock off, with no trip to settings. Taking a lock off always asks first, the same way your other locks unlock, even with the collection open. Asked for in #678.

- Posts and reels saved into a locked collection now stay out of Saved's All, Posts, Reels and search while it's locked, and its tile hides its cover. They come back after an unlock once Saved refreshes. Asked for in #678.

- `Center names in chats` is new under Messages. The name at the top of a chat sits in the middle, as close as the call buttons allow. Starts off. `Ask before a call` moved to Manager's Interaction group. Asked for in #779.

- `Pinch for clear mode` is new under Reels. Pinching a reel toggles clear mode. `Hide the exit button in clear mode` hides its round button. `Pinch to zoom` wins when on. Both start off. Requested in #744.

- `Let the screen sleep when a reel stops` is new under Reels. With this on, a paused reel lets your phone's screen timeout run. Starts off. `Control the reel above comments` moved to Manager's Comments group. Asked for in #777.

- `Expand captions on reels` is new under Reels and comes with `Expand captions`. Reels show their whole caption. It's separate from the feed one, since a long caption covers more of the video. Starts off. Asked for in #752.

- `Hide Threads posts` is new under Reels, right after `Hide stories in Reels`. It takes out the cards Instagram slips between reels to get you onto Threads. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Asked for in #765.

- `Hide Not interested and Interested` is new under Reels and takes those two buttons off a reel. `Hide 'Are you interested?' bubbles` now covers Home only. If you had it on, the Reels one starts on too. Asked for in #769.

- `Stop swipe to Messages` is new under Feed, after `Stop swipe to create`. On the classic tab bar, a swipe left on Home no longer slides Messages in. The Messages button still works. Starts off. Asked for in #770.

- `Expand captions` is new under Feed. Feed posts show their whole caption. `Caption lines before more` sets a number of lines instead, from one to ten. Stories keep short captions. Starts off. Requested in #771.

- `Hide the line under names` is new under Feed. It clears the song, place and labels under a post's name. `Hide the line under names on reels` covers Reels. Sponsored labels stay. Both start off. Requested in #771.

- `Keep the place` goes with `Hide the line under names`. A post's place stays on that line by itself, so it sits still instead of taking turns with the song. Asked for in #771.

- `Only after a long hold` goes under `Keep 2x after you let go`. A quick hold to peek at 2x goes back to normal speed when you let go, and a hold of about 3 seconds keeps 2x. Asked for in #552.

- `Keep the name while you hold` goes under `Hold for 2x on feed videos`. The name over a feed video stays while you hold it at 2x, and Instagram's 2x and time labels stay off. Asked for in #552.

- `Hide Followers and Following on profiles` is new under Profiles. `Hide follower counts` takes the numbers off and leaves the words. `Hide Followers and Following` takes both buttons away and closes the gap. Both start off. Requested in #771.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you react`. Reacting to something someone sent lets them see you read up to it, and anything newer stays unseen. Starts off. Requested in #772.

- The viewing history page has a grid button next to Clear. It shows what you watched as big covers, three across. Tap it again for the list. The page remembers your pick. Requested in #773.

- `Auto scroll in the reel menu` under Reels puts Turn on auto scroll or Turn off auto scroll in a reel's three-dot menu. It works on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll too. Requested in #768.

- `Hide notifications by type` under Notifications lists the kinds of notifications Instagram has sent you, each with a line from one, and takes the ones you tick off the page. Requested in #756.

- Saving a reel gets its picture and sound at the same time now, instead of one after the other, so saves finish sooner. Asked about in #493.

- A feed post's three-dot menu can now show Block and Playback speed. Turn on `Block in a post's menu` and `Speed in a post's menu` under Downloads. Requested in #743.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` under Feed has five more to untick. A reel's menu can drop Remix and sequence, Use as reference, Use template and Get Edits, and `Loop this video` can come off reel and feed video menus. Asked for in #707.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` has more to untick: Save, the Download rows, Details, About this account, Block, Hide posts from this account, Loop this story and Add to Stories priority, story menus included. Asked for in #707.

- Press and hold the Download button on a story to pick `Download` or `Save all`, which saves every story in the set you're watching. It comes with `Download button on stories`. Requested in #745.

- Under `Default playback quality` there's a new `Drop quality to keep playing` switch. It's on to start, so a slow connection drops a rung instead of stalling. Turn it off to keep the quality you picked. Requested in #761.

- Two new switches under Feed, next to `Hide the Like button`. `Hide counts on posts` takes the like, comment, share and repost numbers off feed posts and keeps the buttons. `Hide Liked by` takes the "Liked by" line off them. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the tag icon on posts` sits right under `Hide the audio icon on posts` in Feed. It takes the little person icon off posts with people tagged in them, and product tags keep theirs. Also from #762.

- `Hide the empty profile prompt` is new in Profiles, under `Hide the Create button`. While your profile has no posts, it takes the big "first post" prompt off your grid. Other people's empty profiles don't change. Asked for in #762.

- Two new switches follow `Hide suggested accounts in Messages`. `Hide the New message button` takes the pencil off your messages. `Hide suggestions in New message` drops Suggested people from the New message and new group screens, and search still works. Asked for in #762.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile now opens the menu's Saved page, starting on All with a back arrow, instead of the grid of collections. Accounts Instagram hasn't given that page yet still get the grid. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the New collection button` sits under `Fast scroll in Saved` in Profiles. It takes the + off the top of Saved, on both Saved screens, and your collections stay where they are. No restart needed. Also from #762.

- `Hide the Reels tab in Saved` and `Hide Saved on the Search tab` are new under `Hide the New collection button`. Saved reels still show under All, and the Search tab change needs a restart. Asked for in #810.

- Two more switches under Comments. `Hide likes on comments` takes the heart and like count off every comment. `Hide the comment box` takes away the box at the bottom, so the comments get that space. Asked for in #762.

- Tap to play's `Where videos wait` can treat Explore on its own now, with four new picks, `Everywhere but Explore`, `Only in Explore`, `Reels and Explore` and `Everywhere but Reels and Explore`. Reels opened from Explore count as Reels. Asked for in #762.

- The video under the HushGram settings pauses while they're open, so it stops playing and loading where you can't see it. Closing the settings plays it again, and a video you'd tapped with Tap to play on stays tapped. Asked for in #762.

- `Light settings page` sits under `Black settings page` in Settings entry. It turns the HushGram settings and the pages they open white, with dark text and status bar icons. The rest of Instagram keeps its own look. Asked for in #762.

- A song's page, the one you reach by tapping a reel's song, has a Download icon beside Save now. It saves the whole song as audio, like `Download full song` in a reel's menu, and follows that switch. Asked for in #741.

- `Find the reel you came from` labels the reel it finds with You just watched, over a dimmed tile with a colored edge, for a few seconds. The old white outline was easy to miss. Asked for in #781.

- `Hide reels with few views` adds limits for maximum views, likes and comments per 1,000 views, length and age, plus `Newest first` and `Also on Home`. 0 means off. Reels from accounts you follow still play. Asked for in #780.

- A chat's clock button menu has `Select messages` now, under Export chat. Tick loaded messages, then copy, share or save them to a text file in Downloads. It comes with `Export a chat as text`. Asked for in #778.

- In Manager's Expert mode the six comment patches have a Comments group of their own now, like the Comments page in HushGram settings, and `HushGram launch screen` moved to Settings. Interaction and Interface were getting too long to scan.

- `Keep the tab bar on reel links` is new under Interaction, with its switch in Reels settings. A reel link from another app, like WhatsApp, plays on your current tab with the tab bar under it. Starts off. Asked for in #385.

- `Blocked words` under `Hide reels by caption words` takes an @name too, like `@cnn`. That account's reels leave the Reels tab, and with `Also on Home` on its posts leave Home as well. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in comments` is new under `Hide reels by caption words`. It hides comments that hold a word from your list, and comments by an account the list names with @. Replies to a hidden comment go with it. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in search`, new under `Hide reels by caption words`, takes a row out of the Explore grid and search results when a post in it matches your list, by its words or its account. Asked for in #807.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` works in chats where you have a Blend with the person too. Swiping up goes through the reels shared in the chat first, and the Blend's reels come after them. Asked for in #804.

- The `Blocked words` row under `Hide reels by caption words` now says how much your list has hidden, in the last 24 hours and in all, counting reels, Home posts and comments. Asked for in #807.

- `Instagram settings page` is new under `Settings entry`. HushGram's settings look like Instagram's own, with plain rows, gray section names and its round switch, in dark or light to match. It wins over the Black and Light looks. Asked for in #797.

- `Don't open reels from chats` is new under Messages. A reel someone shares in a chat stays closed when you tap it, and a short note says reels from chats are off. Photos, videos and shared posts still open. Asked for in #810.

- `Reels on Home below the name` is new under Feed. Reels on Home show like other posts, with the name and three-dot menu above the video instead of on it. Live videos and other reels keep Instagram's layout. Asked for in #788.

- `Time on the seek bar` is new under `Seek bar on stories`. It shows the time played and the story's length, like 0:03 / 0:15, and a tap (or `Show the time left`) counts down instead. Asked for in #784.

- `Copy text in the story menu` is new under Stories. Copy text in a story's three-dot menu copies the words Instagram read in the picture, or opens Google Lens when it found none. Starts off. Asked for in #789.

- `Full-size Reels icon` is new under Tab bar. Instagram's Reels icon is narrower than the others, so it looks small. This draws it a bit bigger to match, on top of your Tab icon size. Starts off. Asked for in #793.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

HushGram still patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so you patch the same way as last time. Most of this release came from you: 57 of the changes below started with one of your reports or requests. You can blur a chat behind a message you're holding, record calls, lock a collection right from Saved, keep the tab bar on reel links and hide comments that use your blocked words. There are 44 fixes too.

Fixes

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, a story you open no longer covers the whole screen for a moment before jumping up above the gesture bar. Reported in #618.

- Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.

- The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.

- The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.

- `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.

- `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.

- Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.

- `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.

- Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.

- With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.

- Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.

- The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.

- An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.

- The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.

- `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.

- Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.

- `Fill the screen` goes grey with a line saying why while `Show the whole reel` is on, since that switch wins and reels kept their side bars. Reported in #755.

- `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.

- The seek bar on reels no longer sits under the floating tab bar after you come back from picture in picture. Reported in #450.

- With the tab bar hiding on Reels, dragging a reel's seek bar no longer leaves it sitting on top of the caption once you let go. Reported in #450.

- Logging in with Facebook no longer stops on Facebook's "link may be broken" page and a spinner that never ends. The Facebook app turns away a patched Instagram, so the login goes through your browser now. Reported in #760.

- Reels that run behind the glass tab bar sit where they should again instead of up against the top of the screen with a black band under them. Reported in #763.

- Unfolding a foldable with `Glass tab bar` on keeps every tab in Instagram's side rail now, lined up. Search and your profile used to go missing from it and the rest sat out of line. Reported in #764.

- `Thicker story progress bar` thickens the bar again with a seek bar shape picked. 0.0.21 left a shaped bar as thin as before. Now its line grows like the standard bar's, and the waves keep their size. Reported in #775.

- With `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed` on, tapping a feed video no longer stops it on its cover or leaves it under a play button. Instagram set the video up for Reels before HushGram caught the tap. Reported in #706.

- `Sent follow requests` now catches the Requested button at the top of a profile. Since 456 Instagram sets that button another way, so a request you sent from someone's profile never made it onto the list. Reported in #690.

- `Text size` stays put when you turn your phone or change one of its settings. Captions in the feed went back to your phone's own size after that, until Instagram was closed and opened again. Reported in #782.

- Signing in no longer closes Instagram on a phone without Google Play services, like a de-Googled ROM or one running microG. `Run without Play services` is on by default and has no switch. Reported in #767 and #748.

- On a narrow phone, HushGram's buttons at the top of a chat fold into one More button that holds all of them, so the chat's name shows and the last call button isn't cut off. Reported in #802.

- `Keep the name while you hold` goes under `Hold for 2x on feed videos`. The name over a feed video stays while you hold it at 2x, and Instagram's 2x and time labels stay off. Asked for in #552.

- `Hide Followers and Following on profiles` is new under Profiles. `Hide follower counts` takes the numbers off and leaves the words. `Hide Followers and Following` takes both buttons away and closes the gap. Both start off. Requested in #771.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you react`. Reacting to something someone sent lets them see you read up to it, and anything newer stays unseen. Starts off. Requested in #772.

- The viewing history page has a grid button next to Clear. It shows what you watched as big covers, three across. Tap it again for the list. The page remembers your pick. Requested in #773.

- `Auto scroll in the reel menu` under Reels puts Turn on auto scroll or Turn off auto scroll in a reel's three-dot menu. It works on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll too. Requested in #768.

- `Hide notifications by type` under Notifications lists the kinds of notifications Instagram has sent you, each with a line from one, and takes the ones you tick off the page. Requested in #756.

- Saving a reel gets its picture and sound at the same time now, instead of one after the other, so saves finish sooner. Asked about in #493.

- A feed post's three-dot menu can now show Block and Playback speed. Turn on `Block in a post's menu` and `Speed in a post's menu` under Downloads. Requested in #743.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` under Feed has five more to untick. A reel's menu can drop Remix and sequence, Use as reference, Use template and Get Edits, and `Loop this video` can come off reel and feed video menus. Asked for in #707.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` has more to untick: Save, the Download rows, Details, About this account, Block, Hide posts from this account, Loop this story and Add to Stories priority, story menus included. Asked for in #707.

- Press and hold the Download button on a story to pick `Download` or `Save all`, which saves every story in the set you're watching. It comes with `Download button on stories`. Requested in #745.

- Under `Default playback quality` there's a new `Drop quality to keep playing` switch. It's on to start, so a slow connection drops a rung instead of stalling. Turn it off to keep the quality you picked. Requested in #761.

- Two new switches under Feed, next to `Hide the Like button`. `Hide counts on posts` takes the like, comment, share and repost numbers off feed posts and keeps the buttons. `Hide Liked by` takes the "Liked by" line off them. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the tag icon on posts` sits right under `Hide the audio icon on posts` in Feed. It takes the little person icon off posts with people tagged in them, and product tags keep theirs. Also from #762.

- `Hide the empty profile prompt` is new in Profiles, under `Hide the Create button`. While your profile has no posts, it takes the big "first post" prompt off your grid. Other people's empty profiles don't change. Asked for in #762.

- Two new switches follow `Hide suggested accounts in Messages`. `Hide the New message button` takes the pencil off your messages. `Hide suggestions in New message` drops Suggested people from the New message and new group screens, and search still works. Asked for in #762.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile now opens the menu's Saved page, starting on All with a back arrow, instead of the grid of collections. Accounts Instagram hasn't given that page yet still get the grid. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the New collection button` sits under `Fast scroll in Saved` in Profiles. It takes the + off the top of Saved, on both Saved screens, and your collections stay where they are. No restart needed. Also from #762.

- `Hide the Reels tab in Saved` and `Hide Saved on the Search tab` are new under `Hide the New collection button`. Saved reels still show under All, and the Search tab change needs a restart. Asked for in #810.

- Two more switches under Comments. `Hide likes on comments` takes the heart and like count off every comment. `Hide the comment box` takes away the box at the bottom, so the comments get that space. Asked for in #762.

- Tap to play's `Where videos wait` can treat Explore on its own now, with four new picks, `Everywhere but Explore`, `Only in Explore`, `Reels and Explore` and `Everywhere but Reels and Explore`. Reels opened from Explore count as Reels. Asked for in #762.

- The video under the HushGram settings pauses while they're open, so it stops playing and loading where you can't see it. Closing the settings plays it again, and a video you'd tapped with Tap to play on stays tapped. Asked for in #762.

- `Light settings page` sits under `Black settings page` in Settings entry. It turns the HushGram settings and the pages they open white, with dark text and status bar icons. The rest of Instagram keeps its own look. Asked for in #762.

- A song's page, the one you reach by tapping a reel's song, has a Download icon beside Save now. It saves the whole song as audio, like `Download full song` in a reel's menu, and follows that switch. Asked for in #741.

- `Find the reel you came from` labels the reel it finds with You just watched, over a dimmed tile with a colored edge, for a few seconds. The old white outline was easy to miss. Asked for in #781.

- `Hide reels with few views` adds limits for maximum views, likes and comments per 1,000 views, length and age, plus `Newest first` and `Also on Home`. 0 means off. Reels from accounts you follow still play. Asked for in #780.

- A chat's clock button menu has `Select messages` now, under Export chat. Tick loaded messages, then copy, share or save them to a text file in Downloads. It comes with `Export a chat as text`. Asked for in #778.

- In Manager's Expert mode the six comment patches have a Comments group of their own now, like the Comments page in HushGram settings, and `HushGram launch screen` moved to Settings. Interaction and Interface were getting too long to scan.

- `Keep the tab bar on reel links` is new under Interaction, with its switch in Reels settings. A reel link from another app, like WhatsApp, plays on your current tab with the tab bar under it. Starts off. Asked for in #385.

- `Blocked words` under `Hide reels by caption words` takes an @name too, like `@cnn`. That account's reels leave the Reels tab, and with `Also on Home` on its posts leave Home as well. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in comments` is new under `Hide reels by caption words`. It hides comments that hold a word from your list, and comments by an account the list names with @. Replies to a hidden comment go with it. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in search`, new under `Hide reels by caption words`, takes a row out of the Explore grid and search results when a post in it matches your list, by its words or its account. Asked for in #807.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` works in chats where you have a Blend with the person too. Swiping up goes through the reels shared in the chat first, and the Blend's reels come after them. Asked for in #804.

- The `Blocked words` row under `Hide reels by caption words` now says how much your list has hidden, in the last 24 hours and in all, counting reels, Home posts and comments. Asked for in #807.

- `Instagram settings page` is new under `Settings entry`. HushGram's settings look like Instagram's own, with plain rows, gray section names and its round switch, in dark or light to match. It wins over the Black and Light looks. Asked for in #797.

- `Don't open reels from chats` is new under Messages. A reel someone shares in a chat stays closed when you tap it, and a short note says reels from chats are off. Photos, videos and shared posts still open. Asked for in #810.

- `Reels on Home below the name` is new under Feed. Reels on Home show like other posts, with the name and three-dot menu above the video instead of on it. Live videos and other reels keep Instagram's layout. Asked for in #788.

- `Time on the seek bar` is new under `Seek bar on stories`. It shows the time played and the story's length, like 0:03 / 0:15, and a tap (or `Show the time left`) counts down instead. Asked for in #784.

- `Copy text in the story menu` is new under Stories. Copy text in a story's three-dot menu copies the words Instagram read in the picture, or opens Google Lens when it found none. Starts off. Asked for in #789.

- `Full-size Reels icon` is new under Tab bar. Instagram's Reels icon is narrower than the others, so it looks small. This draws it a bit bigger to match, on top of your Tab icon size. Starts off. Asked for in #793.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

hushthreads.title: v0.0.18
hushthreads.body:
HushThreads v0.0.18 has 26 patches for Threads 455.0.0.55.72 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it patches that version only, on all nine APKMirror variants. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so you need Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Update Threads to 455 before you patch.

Four new patches. `Spoof SIM region` lets Threads see a SIM from a country you pick, and `Full size profile pictures` opens someone's profile picture in a viewer of its own. `Change package name` and `Change app name` put HushThreads next to your regular Threads as a second app. The suggested threads under a post you open can go now too.

**Your reports in this release**

- [#8](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/8) found that Meta's own Instagram won't open Threads posts in HushThreads. The note under Links in HushThreads settings points to the way round it now, which is patching Instagram with HushGram in the same Morphe Manager.
- [#22](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/22) asked to see a profile picture full size. `Full size profile pictures` opens it in its own viewer with pinch to zoom, and with Save media on there's a Save button too.
- [#23](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/23) asked for a way to keep the regular Threads and have HushThreads beside it. `Change package name` and `Change app name` do that, and the copy has its own sign-in.
- [#24](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/24) asked to hide the suggested threads under a post's replies. `Hide suggested threads` on the Feed page takes them away, and it starts on.
- [#25](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/25) asked to change the region Threads sees. Turn on `Spoof SIM region` under Privacy and pick a country, and Threads reads that country's SIM and carrier instead of yours.

## Threads

- Meta's own Instagram won't open Threads posts in HushThreads, and the note about it under Links in HushThreads settings now tells you what to do instead. Patch Instagram with HushGram in the same Morphe Manager so both share one key, and Instagram opens Threads posts and profiles right in HushThreads. Asked about in #8.
- New `Spoof SIM region` patch. Threads sees a SIM and network from the country you pick, with one of that country's real carriers, instead of your own. There are 69 countries to choose from. It starts off, so turn it on and pick one in HushThreads settings > Privacy. Meta can still go by your connection and your account, so it won't hide where you are by itself. Asked for in #25.
- HushThreads now patches Threads 455.0.0.55.72 only, on all nine APKMirror variants (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 and x86). Update Threads to 455 before you patch. v0.0.17 is the last release for 454.0.0.54.79.
- Hide ads and Hide suggested users keep up with how Threads 455 stores For You. It writes every page and every single post straight into the feed cache now, and it can slip an ad into a page you're already scrolling. All of those go through the filters, and a page keeps its posts as they were when an ad gets turned away.
- Hide suggested users also takes the suggested threads off the bottom of a post you open. It has its own switch, `Hide suggested threads`, under the other two on the Feed page, and it starts on. The post and its replies stay. Asked for in #24.
- New `Full size profile pictures` patch. When you open someone's profile picture on their profile, it shows full size in a viewer of its own instead of Threads' small circle. You can pinch to zoom, and with Save media on there's a Save button too. It's in Manager's default selection, but its switch under Appearance in HushThreads settings starts off. Asked for in #22.
- The bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Older Manager builds can't load it, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer first.
- With `Show exact post times` on and a large font, a post's time stays in one piece. Under a long name it used to break after the month or the day, with "Nov" on one line and "5, 2:30 AM" on the next. Now the whole time moves under the name when it doesn't fit beside it.
- New `Change package name` and `Change app name` patches. Keep your regular Threads and install HushThreads next to it as a second app with its own sign-in. Neither patch is in Manager's default selection. HushThreads settings show the copy's package name and app name under Set when you patched. Asked for in #23.

## Tooling

- The full patch check, which applies every patch, passes with `Change package name` in the bundle. It used to read the renamed package and its renamed permissions as an unknown app asking for new permissions. The checks that compare a patched build with the clean one follow Threads 455 too, where three of the places they read had moved.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.18 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Get Threads 455.0.0.55.72 for your phone (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 or x86) and patch that. v0.0.17 was the last release for Threads 454.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change package name`, `Change app name`, `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first, or patch with `Change package name` to keep both.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

1106 runtime tests and 346 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 26 patches applied without forcing to Threads 455.0.0.55.72, and the release receipt records the run. The dependency advisory check passed.

hushtelegram.title: v0.0.27
hushtelegram.body:
HushTelegram v0.0.27 has 81 patches for Telegram 13.3.1, both the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 73461) and telegram.org's (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 73469). It moves to Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you refresh the source. Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 can be patched now too, with 78 of the patches. New in this one: a duress passcode, V2Ray-style servers next to Free proxies, folder tabs at the bottom of the chat list, videos in another player and settings in Italian. When Telegram turns down the API ID at sign-in you can type your own right there, with no repatching. `Unlock Premium features` is gone, and so are the switches that opened Premium's paid parts on this phone.

New in this release

- When Telegram turns down the app's API ID at sign-in, the message now has an `Enter your API ID` button. Type the `App api_id` and `App api_hash` from my.telegram.org/apps and Telegram restarts and asks for the login code with them, so there's no repatching. The pair stays on the phone, out of settings exports and reports, and `Remove` in the same box goes back to the app's own ID. (#107, #111)

- `Duress passcode` is a new switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. It needs a Telegram passcode. Pick a second code in `Set duress passcode`, and if someone ever makes you unlock Telegram, type that code instead of your real one. `What the duress passcode does` picks what happens next: log out every account (the default), log out only the open one, delete every account, or delete only the open one. Pick a deleting choice and a warning pops up, and it stays written under the row for as long as that choice is set. Typed the first time, the code looks like a wrong passcode and nothing happens yet. Typed again, the accounts are deleted for good, and an account with a cloud password, which Telegram waits a week to delete, is logged out meanwhile. Either way HushTelegram clears what it kept, like deleted messages, edit history and call recordings, and Telegram's downloaded media goes too. With every account gone, Telegram opens on its sign-in screen. When only the open account goes, the lists that hide or arrange your other accounts' chats stay. Your real passcode still unlocks as usual, and only a salted hash of the duress code is stored, never the code itself. (#79)

- `V2Ray-style servers` is a new switch with `Free proxies` in Chat list, off by default. Paste vmess://, vless://, trojan:// and ss:// links into `Your V2Ray links` and Telegram connects through the fastest of your servers that answers, by way of a small proxy that runs inside Telegram with one entry in Telegram's proxy list. Links in `Your proxy lists` count too, base64 subscriptions included. `V2Ray server` shows how each one did, lets you pick one and tests them all again. VMess, VLESS and Trojan work over TCP or WebSocket, with or without TLS, and Shadowsocks with aes-128-gcm, aes-256-gcm or chacha20-ietf-poly1305. Links that need REALITY, XTLS, gRPC, QUIC, Hysteria, dnstt or Shadowsocks 2022 are skipped, and the row says which kinds it left out. Turning it off takes its entry out of the list and leaves your other proxies alone. Calls don't go through it. (#71)

- A switch that's new since you last opened HushTelegram settings gets a small dot after its name, and so does the closed section it's in, so you can see what an update added without reading every page. Open the section and the dot moves to the new switch. Close it again, or close the settings, and the dots are gone. Search shows no dots. Nothing shows a dot the first time the settings open after you install, so the first dots come with the update after the one that adds them. (#96)

- Plus Messenger can be patched too. Pick Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 (`org.telegram.plus`, version code 22710, the APKMirror download with all four architectures) in Morphe Manager and it offers 78 of the 81 patches, each one read against Plus's own build. Plus keeps its own package, so it installs beside a patched Telegram. (#7)

- View-once and self-destructing photos and videos get three new options, all off by default. `Show view-once and timed media unblurred` (Reveal spoilers) takes the blur off them in the chat. `Also allow screenshots of view-once and timed media` (Add Repeat to the message menu) lets you capture the screen that opens them, and a secret chat needs `Also allow screenshots in secret chats` as well. With `Also save view-once and timed media` on, the message menu's `Save to Downloads` shows up on them too, even when Telegram only keeps the encrypted file. (#82)

- Folder tabs can now sit at the bottom of the chat list, right above the bottom bar, so they're easy to reach with one hand. Turn on `Folder tabs at the bottom` in HushTelegram settings > Chat list. It starts off, and it isn't available on Plus Messenger. (#97)

- Videos in chats can now open in another player like VLC or MX Player. Turn on `Play videos in another app` in HushTelegram settings > Playback. Videos you haven't downloaded stream as they play, so there's no need to save them first, and secret, view-once and protected videos stay in Telegram's player. It starts off. (#99)

- New `Always show translate bar` switch on the Conversations page, off by default. The translate bar now shows up in chats where Telegram didn't spot another language, which helps with things like Hindi typed in Latin letters. Without Premium it works through `Translate with an outside service`. If `Hide translate bar` is on too, the bar stays hidden. (#98)

- New `Add Send photo to the link preview menu` switch on the Conversations page, off by default. It comes with Add Repeat to the message menu. When a link preview in the message box has a picture, its menu gets a Send photo row that sends the picture as a normal photo. Your text goes with it as the caption if it fits, otherwise it stays in the box. (#101)

- HushTelegram's settings speak Italian now. Switch Telegram to Italian and every HushTelegram page, switch, search result and message follows. (#100)

- New `Hide Downloads button` switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button no longer pops up in the bar at the top of the chat list while a file downloads, and your downloads are still in the Downloads tab when you search. (#113)

- New `Always show Downloads button` switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button stays in the bar at the top of the chat list even when nothing is downloading, so your downloads are one tap away. It still steps aside while you search, and turning the switch off takes it away again without a restart. If `Hide Downloads button` is on too, the button stays hidden. Both Downloads switches take hold as soon as you close HushTelegram settings. (#113)

- New `Keep downloaded stickers` switch on the Look and feel page, off by default. Telegram's automatic cache cleanup leaves sticker files alone, so sticker packs you've used don't have to download again. Clearing the cache yourself still removes them. (#110)

- New `Sticker panel size` row on the Look and feel page, set to Telegram's size until you change it. Large and Larger show fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and in its search results. A chat picks up a new size the next time you open it. (#110)

- New `Keep emoji statuses moving` switch on the Ads page, off by default. Animated emoji statuses next to names keep playing instead of stopping after two plays, which uses a little more battery. Restart Telegram after you change it. (#112)

- New `Rename on this phone` switch on the Look and feel page under `Special contacts`, off by default. It adds `Rename on this phone` to a profile's three dots menu and to the chat list's long press menu, so you can give a person, bot, group or channel a name that only your phone shows. The name shows in place of theirs in the chat list, in chats and on profiles right away, with no restart. Leave the field empty or tap `Remove` to get Telegram's name back. Telegram never gets the name. Anything you send that would carry it, like a mention, adding someone to contacts or sharing a contact, goes out with the real name, and contacts Telegram saves to your phone's address book get the real name too. Your own accounts can't be renamed, up to 50 names fit, and the names go along in a settings file. (#104)

- New `Open Saved Messages on its media` switch on the Chat list page under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. Tapping Saved Messages in the chat list then opens its shared media page, with your saved chats, media, files, links, music and voice messages in tabs. To get to the chat itself, tap the menu on the Chats tab and pick `View as Messages`. Putting Saved Messages in a folder needs no switch, since a folder's `Add Chats` list already has it. (#103)

Fixes

- With `Bypass channel restrictions` on, forwarding a protected video or photo you haven't downloaded yet works better. Videos that come in several qualities were waiting on the wrong file and never went out. A download that stops now starts again, a stuck forward no longer holds up the next one, and HushTelegram tells you when it's downloading first and when the download fails. Photos that aren't on your phone download too, and `Save to Downloads` finds the quality you're watching. (#84)

- `Hide pinned message bar` now reaches a chat left open under HushTelegram settings as soon as the settings close. That chat used to keep its old bar until you left the app or opened the chat again. (#85)

Other changes

- Patching for a root mount in Morphe Manager now starts with Repair Firebase push registration off. A mount keeps Telegram's own certificate, which is the thing that patch stands in for. You can still turn it on, and every other install starts with it on as before.

- HushTelegram now patches Telegram 13.3.1, telegram.org's build (version code 73469) and the Google Play build (73461). Plus Messenger stays on 13.2.2.1.

- HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, the one in Morphe Manager 2.7.0 and morphe-desktop 2.3.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you add this release.

- Remove the Unlock Premium features patch.

- Remove the `Add Save to Gallery to stories` switch from Add Repeat to the message menu.

- Remove the `Emoji status on this phone` switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.

- Remove the `Unlock Premium app icons` switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.

- Remove the `Move All Chats` switch from Hide folder tab counters.

- Remove the `Pin chats on this phone` switch from Hide folder tab counters.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.7.0 or newer. Older Managers won't load this bundle, since it's built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram. If you already have it, refresh the source. Morphe Manager shows it as signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc.
3. Get Telegram 13.3.1. From Google Play that's `org.telegram.messenger` with version code 73461, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) carries too. telegram.org's build is `org.telegram.messenger.web` with version code 73469, from the [Download button](https://telegram.org/android). Once telegram.org moves past 13.3.1, Telegram's own [Telegram APKs for Android](https://t.me/TAndroidAPK) channel still has this one. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.26? Patch 13.3.1 and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, it's refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then tap **Enter your API ID** in Telegram's message and type its `App api_id` and `App api_hash`. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

repos.body:
# [2.4.0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0) (2026-11-26)


### Bug Fixes

* Correct Strip libs and output naming ([7a59d00](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/7a59d0060050a2e1fdc816046544b73ce036354c))
* Hide language subtext when it matches the title ([b5c5ae8](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/b5c5ae89f657ceed8ad6ad620f0f5383621a2d32))
* Prevent concurrent writes from corrupting config ([6e0fb6c](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/6e0fb6c6afb7a0098132e97b41b479c9b4831ce4))
* Show update badge only when relevant patches are available ([#455](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues/455)) ([4c9a3b8](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/4c9a3b8f972bf7ac22418258776b25e6f3146508))
* Stop root mount from keeping the old patched APK ([97be3df](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/97be3df70f3d90ea6304d09f6494024fbe58e419))
* Support fractional scaling on X11 and XWayland ([#446](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues/446)) ([edfe717](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/edfe717d39456e26ffb6e2cd0a18fca2b2b73e8c))
* Unmount root mounted apps with the whole command ([#460](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues/460)) ([547f1f5](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/547f1f52558b85f850b2890b5760de01e8e5f40b))
* Update Patcher and ARSCLib dependency ([683899a](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/683899a9f2bcb531a3998de8ee3396dd6237f720))


### Features

* Add Codeberg and JSON patch source support ([b37c7b1](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/b37c7b1e3c8743147b51884b80eeca5236c7ec90))
* Add option to keep original APKs for repatching ([#445](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues/445)) ([4c8659b](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/4c8659b25f9320993c4a405a20dda49399c76cc6))
* Install patched apps compiled with their baseline profile ([#459](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues/459)) ([5950617](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/5950617dfff3f286821c068c9d9d416612291b42))


### Performance Improvements

* Speed up startup and loading of apps and patch options ([#454](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues/454)) ([9683a7d](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/commit/9683a7d82fb5b1c9dc010d2228f213bddf7b1481))

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).
